To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a new, well-functioning rat model to study microcirculatory parameters in the urinary bladder using intravial fluorescence microscopy is established.
the intravital fluorescence microscopic characteristics of the microvasculature of the rat bladder under physiological conditions are stable during a 180-min observation period.
we developed a novel, well functioning and highly reproducible model to investigate the microcirculation and the leukocyte-endo-thelial cell interactions of the bladder in rats.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a standard rat model of the urinary bladder to study microcirculatory changes under physiological pressure conditions by using the most advanced fluorescent microscopic techniques.
a new method for the intravital microscopic study of the urinary bladder microcirculation in rats.
the microcirculatory properties of the urinary bladder of rats under physiological pressure conditions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the urinary bladder microcirculation of rats is stable under physiological pressure conditions.
intravesical pressure does not influence the microcirculation and the microcirculation does not affect the intravesical bladder pressure in the rat bladder under physiological filling conditions.
this model is suitable for long-term observations and that it can be used to investigate the effects of different drugs on the microcirculation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the microcirculatory parameters of the rat bladder remain stable for at least 3 h.
the microcirculation parameters of the bladder are stable during the first 3 h of filling.
the urinary bladder is a very stable organ with respect to its microcirculation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the intravesical microcirculation can be easily studied in rats by intravital fluorescence microscopy.
the intravital microscopy of the rat urinary bladder is possible.
the bladder microcirculation is very stable over the course of 3 hours.
